title: A Multi-Timestep LSTM Ensemble regressor for Enhanced Short-Term Runoff Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.26244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurately forecasting river runoff is key to managing water resources, controlling floods, and planning agriculture. This study examines the Ajichay River in northwest Iran, a major tributary of Lake Urmia that has experienced increasing water-related stress in recent years. We introduce a daily runoff prediction model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The model combines five LSTM units, each trained on different time intervals ranging from 2 to 6 days, to better capture variations in river flow patterns. To improve performance, each model was fine-tuned using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), a population-based optimization algorithm. The proposed approach was evaluated on unseen data from 2017-2018 using $R^2$, RMSE, and MSE as performance metrics. translated_title: 一种用于增强短期径流预测的多时间步长LSTM集成回归器
translated_abstract: 准确预测河流径流是水资源管理、洪水控制和农业规划的关键。本研究以伊朗西北部的阿吉恰伊河（Ajichay River）为研究对象，该河是乌鲁米耶湖的主要支流，近年来面临着日益加剧的水资源压力。我们提出了一种基于长短期记忆（LSTM）网络的日径流预测模型。该模型结合了五个LSTM单元，每个单元分别在2至6天不等的不同时间间隔上进行训练，以更好地捕捉河流流量模式的变化。为了提升性能，每个模型均采用粒子群优化（PSO）这一基于种群的优化算法进行微调。所提出的方法在2017-2018年的未见数据上进行了评估，采用R²、RMSE和MSE作为性能指标。结果显示出较强的预测准确性，R²值介于74.95%至91.42%之间。此外，研究还应用了多种特征重要性方法来识别（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该研究提出一种由五个不同时间步长（2-6天）LSTM单元组成、并经粒子群优化算法微调的集成回归模型，用于伊朗阿吉恰伊河的日径流预测，在2017-2018年测试数据上取得了74.95%至91.42%的R²精度。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a multi-timestep LSTM ensemble regressor, combining five LSTM units trained on different intervals (2-6 days) and fine-tuned with Particle Swarm Optimization, achieving R² values of 74.95% to 91.42% for daily runoff prediction of Iran's Ajichay River on unseen 2017-2018 data.
